```{r Filtering and preparing ISCO data, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}



# Packages
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(cmdstanr)



# keep only relevant columns
isco_data <- data_basis %>%
  select(item_id, isco_tool_1st, res1_isco_1st, res2_isco_1st)

#Rename columns
setnames(
  data_basis,
  old = c("isco_tool_1st", "res1_isco_1st", "res2_isco_1st"),
  new = c("isco_tool", "isco_human1", "isco_human2")
)

head(data_basis)

#### 1) Select only ISCO, as character
isco_data <- data_basis %>%
  dplyr::select(item_id, isco_human1, isco_human2, isco_tool) %>%
  mutate(across(c(isco_human1, isco_human2, isco_tool), as.character))

### Remove all lines with NAs
isco_data <- isco_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(isco_human1) & !is.na(isco_human2) & !is.na(isco_tool))

# Keep only two categories: "2" and "3"
isco_data <- isco_data %>%
  filter(isco_human1 == "2" | isco_human1 == "3") %>%
  filter(isco_human2 == "2" | isco_human2 == "3") %>%
  filter(isco_tool   == "2" | isco_tool   == "3")

# 1) Number of rows where all three classify as "2"
count_all_2 <- isco_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(isco_human1 == "2", isco_human2 == "2", isco_tool == "2") %>%
  nrow()

# 2) Number of rows where all three classify as "3"
count_all_3 <- isco_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(isco_human1 == "3", isco_human2 == "3", isco_tool == "3") %>%
  nrow()

# 3) Number of rows where at least one value is "2" and at least one value is "3"
count_mixed_2_and_3 <- isco_data %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    any(c(isco_human1, isco_human2, isco_tool) == "2") &
      any(c(isco_human1, isco_human2, isco_tool) == "3")
  ) %>%
  nrow()

# 4) Number of rows where minimum one element is neither "2" nor "3" - should be 0
count_other <- isco_data %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    any(!c(isco_human1, isco_human2, isco_tool) %in% c("2", "3"))
  ) %>%
  nrow()

# Show results
count_all_2         # 235
count_all_3         # 80
count_mixed_2_and_3 # 42
count_other         # 0 

# Reindex item_id (1, 2, 3,...)
isco_data <- isco_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(item_id = dplyr::row_number())

# Collect all observed classes
isco_levels <- isco_data %>%
  dplyr::select(isco_human1, isco_human2, isco_tool) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort() %>%
  as.character() %>%
  as.vector()

# K, number of distinct classes
K <- length(isco_levels)
stopifnot(K >= 2)

# Helper: map original labels to 1..K using isco_levels for stan compatibility
to_index <- function(v) as.integer(factor(v, levels = isco_levels))

# 1) Map original labels to 1..K
isco_data_idx <- isco_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    isco_human1 = to_index(isco_human1),
    isco_human2 = to_index(isco_human2),
    isco_tool   = to_index(isco_tool)
  )

# 2) Long format (now without NAs)
long_data <- isco_data_idx %>%
  dplyr::transmute(item_id, r1 = isco_human1, r2 = isco_human2, r3 = isco_tool) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("r"), names_to = "rater", values_to = "y") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rater_id = as.integer(factor(rater, levels = c("r1", "r2", "r3")))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(item_id, rater_id)

# Robust 1..I indexing
item_ids <- sort(unique(long_data$item_id))
long_data$item_id_idx <- as.integer(factor(long_data$item_id, levels = item_ids))

I <- length(item_ids) # number of items (people interviewed)
J <- 3L # number of raters
N <- nrow(long_data) # number of observations (I * J if no missing)

cat("Items after filtering:", I, "\n")
cat("Observations:", N, "\n")
cat("Classes:", K, "\n")
cat("Class levels:", paste(isco_levels, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```


```{r Modeling with Dawid-Skene in Stan - All 4 Models, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Packages
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(cmdstanr)



# 3) Write Stan model to file 
stan_file <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "src/dawid_skene_isco.stan")
writeLines(con = stan_file, text = '
  data {
    int<lower=2> K;                      // number of categories
    int<lower=1> I;                      // items
    int<lower=1> J;                      // raters
    int<lower=1> N;                      // number of observed ratings
    array[N] int<lower=1, upper=I> ii;   // item index per observation
    array[N] int<lower=1, upper=J> jj;   // rater index per observation
    array[N] int<lower=1, upper=K> y;    // observed category per observation
  
    vector<lower=0>[K] alpha;            // prior for pi
    array[K] vector<lower=0>[K] beta;    // Dirichlet priors for theta rows, vary by true class
  }

parameters {
  simplex[K] pi;                       // prevalence over true classes
  array[J, K] simplex[K] theta;        // confusion rows: for rater j and true class k
}

transformed parameters {
  // log_q_z[i, k] = log p(z_i = k | pi, theta) up to a constant
  array[I] vector[K] log_q_z;

  // Initialize with log pi
  for (i in 1:I) {
    log_q_z[i] = log(pi);
  }

  // Accumulate per observation
  for (n in 1:N) {
    int i = ii[n];
    int j = jj[n];
    int y_n = y[n];
    for (k in 1:K) {
      // Add log categorical pmf of y_n under theta[j, k, :]
      log_q_z[i, k] += categorical_lpmf(y_n | theta[j, k]);
    }
  }
}

model {
  // Priors
  pi ~ dirichlet(alpha);
  for (j in 1:J)
    for (k in 1:K)
      theta[j, k] ~ dirichlet(beta[k]);

  // Marginalized likelihood
  for (i in 1:I) {
    target += log_sum_exp(log_q_z[i]);
  }
}

generated quantities {
  array[I] simplex[K] q_z;
  for (i in 1:I) {
    vector[K] lq = log_q_z[i];
    q_z[i] = softmax(lq);
  }
}
')

# Compile model once
mod <- cmdstan_model(stan_file, cpp_options = list(stan_threads = TRUE))

# Define 4 model configurations
model_configs <- list(
  list(
    name = "alpha11_beta1",
    alpha = c(1.0, 1.0),
    beta = matrix(1.0, nrow = K, ncol = K)
  ),
  list(
    name = "alpha11_beta5diag",
    alpha = c(1.0, 1.0),
    beta = matrix(1.0, nrow = K, ncol = K) + diag(4.0, K)  # 5 on diagonal, 1 elsewhere
  ),
  list(
    name = "alpha300200_beta1",
    alpha = c(300.0, 200.0),
    beta = matrix(1.0, nrow = K, ncol = K)
  ),
  list(
    name = "alpha300200_beta5diag",
    alpha = c(300.0, 200.0),
    beta = matrix(1.0, nrow = K, ncol = K) + diag(4.0, K)  # 5 on diagonal, 1 elsewhere
  )
)

# Fit all 4 models
fits <- list()
for (config in model_configs) {
  cat("\n=== Fitting model:", config$name, "===\n")
  
  stan_data <- list(
    I = I,
    J = J,
    K = K,
    N = N,
    ii = as.integer(long_data$item_id_idx),
    jj = as.integer(long_data$rater_id),
    y  = as.integer(long_data$y),
    alpha = config$alpha,
    beta  = config$beta
  )
  
  fit <- mod$sample(
    data = stan_data,
    seed = 1234,
    chains = 4,
    parallel_chains = 4,
    threads_per_chain = 1,
    iter_warmup = 1000,
    iter_sampling = 4000,
    refresh = 200,
    adapt_delta = 0.99
  )
  
  fits[[config$name]] <- fit
  
  # Check convergence
  s <- fit$summary()
  s$rhat <- as.numeric(s$rhat)
  bad_rhat <- subset(s, rhat > 1.1 & grepl("^(pi|theta)\\b", variable))
  if (nrow(bad_rhat) > 0) {
    cat("WARNING: R-hat values above 1.1:\n")
    print(bad_rhat[, c("variable","rhat","ess_bulk","ess_tail")])
  } else {
    cat("No R-hat values above 1.1\n")
  }
}
```


```{r Posterior summaries and analysis - All Models, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}  
library(dplyr)
library(posterior)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# Use isco_levels (from data preparation chunk)
class_levels <- isco_levels

# Function to analyze a single model
analyze_model <- function(fit, model_name, out_dir, class_levels, isco_data) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  save_plot <- function(p, filename, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(out_dir, filename),
      plot = p,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = dpi
    )
  }
  
  cat("\n=== Analyzing model:", model_name, "===\n")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 0) Basic diagnostics for key parameters
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  diag_tbl <- fit$summary(variables = c("pi", "theta")) %>%
    dplyr::select(variable, rhat, ess_bulk, ess_tail)
  
  diag_bad <- diag_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(rhat), rhat > 1.01) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(rhat))
  
  if (nrow(diag_bad) > 0) {
    cat("Diagnostics with R-hat > 1.01:\n")
    print(diag_bad)
  }
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1) Confusion matrices (theta), posterior mean and uncertainty
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  theta_draws_mat <- fit$draws("theta", format = "draws_matrix")
  theta_mean_vec  <- colMeans(theta_draws_mat)
  
  # Expectation: theta has dimensions [J rater, K true, K given]
  theta_mean_arr <- array(
    theta_mean_vec,
    dim = c(J, K, K),
    dimnames = list(
      rater = c("human1", "human2", "tool"),
      true  = class_levels,
      given = class_levels
    )
  )
  
  theta_human1_mean <- theta_mean_arr["human1", , ]
  theta_human2_mean <- theta_mean_arr["human2", , ]
  theta_tool_mean   <- theta_mean_arr["tool",   , ]
  
  plot_theta <- function(mat, title_txt) {
    long <- reshape2::melt(mat, varnames = c("True", "Given"), value.name = "Prob")
    ggplot(long, aes(x = Given, y = True, fill = Prob)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white") +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkgreen") +
      theme_light() +
      labs(
        title = title_txt,
        x = "Observed class",
        y = "True class C_i"
      ) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  }
  
  p_theta_h1_mean <- plot_theta(theta_human1_mean, paste("Confusion matrix pi^(1) (posterior mean) -", model_name))
  p_theta_h2_mean <- plot_theta(theta_human2_mean, paste("Confusion matrix pi^(2) (posterior mean) -", model_name))
  p_theta_tool_mean <- plot_theta(theta_tool_mean, paste("Confusion matrix pi^(3) (posterior mean) -", model_name))
  
  save_plot(p_theta_h1_mean, "theta_human1_mean.png")
  save_plot(p_theta_h2_mean, "theta_human2_mean.png")
  save_plot(p_theta_tool_mean, "theta_tool_mean.png")
  
  # Posterior SD heatmaps for theta (uncertainty by cell)
  theta_sd_vec <- apply(theta_draws_mat, 2, sd)
  theta_sd_arr <- array(
    theta_sd_vec,
    dim = c(J, K, K),
    dimnames = list(
      rater = c("human1", "human2", "tool"),
      true  = class_levels,
      given = class_levels
    )
  )
  
  p_theta_h1_sd <- plot_theta(theta_sd_arr["human1", , ], paste("Confusion matrix pi^(1) (posterior SD) -", model_name))
  p_theta_h2_sd <- plot_theta(theta_sd_arr["human2", , ], paste("Confusion matrix pi^(2) (posterior SD) -", model_name))
  p_theta_tool_sd <- plot_theta(theta_sd_arr["tool", , ], paste("Confusion matrix pi^(3) (posterior SD) -", model_name))
  
  save_plot(p_theta_h1_sd, "theta_human1_sd.png")
  save_plot(p_theta_h2_sd, "theta_human2_sd.png")
  save_plot(p_theta_tool_sd, "theta_tool_sd.png")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2) Class prevalence (pi), posterior mean and uncertainty
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  pi_means <- colMeans(as_draws_matrix(fit$draws("pi")))
  pi_df <- data.frame(
    class = class_levels,
    prevalence = as.numeric(pi_means)
  )
  
  p_pi_bar <- ggplot(pi_df, aes(x = class, y = prevalence)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#02626f") +
    theme_light() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Posterior mean of class prevalence (p) -", model_name),
      x = "Class",
      y = "Prevalence"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  save_plot(p_pi_bar, "pi_mean_bar.png", width = 6, height = 4)
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2b) Rater level scalar summaries from theta
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  pi_mean_vec <- as.numeric(pi_means)
  names(pi_mean_vec) <- class_levels
  
  weighted_diag_mass <- function(mat, w) sum(diag(mat) * w)
  weighted_offdiag_mass <- function(mat, w) sum((1 - diag(mat)) * w)
  
  rater_summary <- data.frame(
    rater = c("human1", "human2", "tool"),
    weighted_diag_mass = c(
      weighted_diag_mass(theta_human1_mean, pi_mean_vec),
      weighted_diag_mass(theta_human2_mean, pi_mean_vec),
      weighted_diag_mass(theta_tool_mean,   pi_mean_vec)
    ),
    weighted_offdiag_mass = c(
      weighted_offdiag_mass(theta_human1_mean, pi_mean_vec),
      weighted_offdiag_mass(theta_human2_mean, pi_mean_vec),
      weighted_offdiag_mass(theta_tool_mean,   pi_mean_vec)
    )
  )
  
  p_rater_diag <- ggplot(rater_summary, aes(x = rater, y = weighted_diag_mass)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#02626f") +
    theme_light() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Rater summary: Weighted diagonal mass -", model_name),
      x = "Rater",
      y = "Weighted diagonal mass"
    )
  
  save_plot(p_rater_diag, "rater_weighted_diag_mass.png", width = 6, height = 4)
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3) Posterior class probabilities per item (q_i,j = P(C_i = j | data))
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  qz_draws_mat <- fit$draws("q_z", format = "draws_matrix")
  qz_mean_vec  <- colMeans(qz_draws_mat)
  
  qz_mean <- matrix(
    qz_mean_vec,
    nrow = I, ncol = K,
    dimnames = list(item = item_ids, class = class_levels)
  )
  
  qz_df <- as.data.frame(qz_mean)
  p_cols <- paste0("p_", class_levels)
  colnames(qz_df) <- p_cols
  qz_df$item_id <- item_ids
  
  # MAP label
  qz_df$map_class_idx   <- max.col(qz_df[p_cols], ties.method = "first")
  qz_df$map_class_label <- class_levels[qz_df$map_class_idx]
  
  # Uncertainty measures
  eps <- 1e-12
  qz_df$max_p <- apply(qz_df[p_cols], 1, max)
  
  qz_df$entropy <- -rowSums(as.matrix(qz_df[p_cols]) * log(as.matrix(qz_df[p_cols]) + eps))
  
  qz_df$margin <- apply(qz_df[p_cols], 1, function(p) {
    ps <- sort(p, decreasing = TRUE)
    ps[1] - ps[2]
  })
  
  # Credible set per item
  credible_set <- function(p, classes, level = 0.95) {
    o <- order(p, decreasing = TRUE)
    cum <- cumsum(p[o])
    m <- which(cum >= level)[1]
    classes[o[seq_len(m)]]
  }
  qz_df$cs95 <- apply(qz_df[p_cols], 1, function(x) credible_set(x, class_levels, level = 0.95))
  
  # Plots of uncertainty and confidence
  p_maxp_hist <- ggplot(qz_df, aes(x = max_p)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.025, fill = "#333333", color = "white", size = 0.1) +
    theme_light() +
    labs(x = "Posterior max probability", y = "Count",
         title = paste("Model confidence per item -", model_name))
  
  p_entropy_hist <- ggplot(qz_df, aes(x = entropy)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.025, fill = "#333333", color = "white", size = 0.1) +
    theme_light() +
    labs(x = "Posterior entropy", y = "Count",
         title = paste("Item uncertainty (entropy) -", model_name))
  
  p_margin_hist <- ggplot(qz_df, aes(x = margin)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.025, fill = "#333333", color = "white", size = 0.1) +
    theme_light() +
    labs(x = "Posterior margin (top1 minus top2)", y = "Count",
         title = paste("Item uncertainty (margin) -", model_name))
  
  save_plot(p_maxp_hist, "qz_maxp_hist.png", width = 6, height = 4)
  save_plot(p_entropy_hist, "qz_entropy_hist.png", width = 6, height = 4)
  save_plot(p_margin_hist, "qz_margin_hist.png", width = 6, height = 4)
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3b) MAP distribution vs pi (sanity check)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  map_tab <- qz_df %>%
    count(map_class_label, name = "n_map") %>%
    mutate(map_share = n_map / sum(n_map)) %>%
    rename(class = map_class_label)
  
  pi_tab <- data.frame(class = class_levels, pi_mean = as.numeric(pi_means))
  
  map_vs_pi <- left_join(map_tab, pi_tab, by = "class")
  
  p_map_vs_pi <- ggplot(map_vs_pi, aes(x = class)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = map_share), fill = "#02626f") +
    geom_point(aes(y = pi_mean), size = 2) +
    theme_light() +
    labs(
      title = paste("MAP share (bars) vs posterior mean p (points) -", model_name),
      x = "Class",
      y = "Share / prevalence"
    )
  
  save_plot(p_map_vs_pi, "map_share_vs_pi.png", width = 6, height = 4)
  
  # Return summary statistics
  list(
    model_name = model_name,
    pi_means = pi_means,
    pi_df = pi_df,
    theta_human1_mean = theta_human1_mean,
    theta_human2_mean = theta_human2_mean,
    theta_tool_mean = theta_tool_mean,
    rater_summary = rater_summary,
    qz_df = qz_df,
    map_vs_pi = map_vs_pi
  )
}

# Analyze all models and store results
results_list <- list()
for (model_name in names(fits)) {
  out_dir <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "img/model_results/isco/alpha_beta_comparison_300200", model_name)
  results_list[[model_name]] <- analyze_model(
    fits[[model_name]], 
    model_name, 
    out_dir, 
    class_levels, 
    isco_data
  )
}
```


```{r Parameter Comparison Across Models, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(gridExtra)

# Create comparison directory
comp_dir <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "img/model_results/isco/alpha_beta_comparison_300200")
dir.create(comp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Compare pi (prevalence) across models
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pi_comparison <- data.frame()
for (model_name in names(results_list)) {
  pi_df <- results_list[[model_name]]$pi_df
  pi_df$model <- model_name
  pi_comparison <- rbind(pi_comparison, pi_df)
}

p_pi_comparison <- ggplot(pi_comparison, aes(x = class, y = prevalence, fill = model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "alpha11_beta1" = "Alpha=(1,1), Beta=Uniform",
      "alpha11_beta5diag" = "Alpha=(1,1), Beta=5 on diagonal",
      "alpha300200_beta1" = "Alpha=(300,200), Beta=Uniform",
      "alpha300200_beta5diag" = "Alpha=(300,200), Beta=5 on diagonal"
    )
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of posterior mean p across models (ISCO categories 2 and 3)",
    x = "Class",
    y = "Prevalence",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(file.path(comp_dir, "pi_comparison.png"), p_pi_comparison, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 600)
p_pi_comparison

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Compare theta matrices (confusion matrices) across models
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract diagonal elements (accuracy) for each rater
theta_diag_comparison <- data.frame()
for (model_name in names(results_list)) {
  theta_h1 <- results_list[[model_name]]$theta_human1_mean
  theta_h2 <- results_list[[model_name]]$theta_human2_mean
  theta_tool <- results_list[[model_name]]$theta_tool_mean
  
  for (k in 1:K) {
    theta_diag_comparison <- rbind(
      theta_diag_comparison,
      data.frame(
        model = model_name,
        rater = "human1",
        true_class = class_levels[k],
        accuracy = theta_h1[k, k]
      ),
      data.frame(
        model = model_name,
        rater = "human2",
        true_class = class_levels[k],
        accuracy = theta_h2[k, k]
      ),
      data.frame(
        model = model_name,
        rater = "tool",
        true_class = class_levels[k],
        accuracy = theta_tool[k, k]
      )
    )
  }
}

p_theta_diag_comparison <- ggplot(theta_diag_comparison, 
                                   aes(x = true_class, y = accuracy, fill = model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "alpha11_beta1" = "Alpha=(1,1), Beta=Uniform",
      "alpha11_beta5diag" = "Alpha=(1,1), Beta=5 on diagonal",
      "alpha300200_beta1" = "Alpha=(300,200), Beta=Uniform",
      "alpha300200_beta5diag" = "Alpha=(300,200), Beta=5 on diagonal"
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ rater, ncol = 3, 
             labeller = labeller(rater = c("human1" = "Human 1", "human2" = "Human 2", "tool" = "Tool"))) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of diagonal elements (accuracy) across models",
    x = "True class",
    y = "Accuracy",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(file.path(comp_dir, "theta_diag_comparison.png"), p_theta_diag_comparison, 
       width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 600)

# 5) Summary table of key statistics
# ------------------------------------------------------------
summary_table <- data.frame()
for (model_name in names(results_list)) {
  pi_means <- results_list[[model_name]]$pi_means
  rater_sum <- results_list[[model_name]]$rater_summary
  qz_df <- results_list[[model_name]]$qz_df
  
  summary_table <- rbind(
    summary_table,
    data.frame(
      model = model_name,
      pi_class2 = pi_means[1],
      pi_class3 = pi_means[2],
      h1_weighted_diag = rater_sum$weighted_diag_mass[rater_sum$rater == "human1"],
      h2_weighted_diag = rater_sum$weighted_diag_mass[rater_sum$rater == "human2"],
      tool_weighted_diag = rater_sum$weighted_diag_mass[rater_sum$rater == "tool"],
      mean_entropy = mean(qz_df$entropy),
      median_entropy = median(qz_df$entropy),
      mean_max_p = mean(qz_df$max_p),
      median_max_p = median(qz_df$max_p)
    )
  )
}

print(summary_table)

# Save summary table
write.csv(summary_table, file.path(comp_dir, "summary_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Detailed theta comparison - heatmaps side by side
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create a function to plot all theta matrices for comparison
plot_theta_comparison <- function(rater_name, rater_idx) {
  plots_list <- list()
  for (model_name in names(results_list)) {
    if (rater_name == "human1") {
      theta_mat <- results_list[[model_name]]$theta_human1_mean
    } else if (rater_name == "human2") {
      theta_mat <- results_list[[model_name]]$theta_human2_mean
    } else {
      theta_mat <- results_list[[model_name]]$theta_tool_mean
    }
    
    long <- reshape2::melt(theta_mat, varnames = c("True", "Given"), value.name = "Prob")
    rater_label <- switch(rater_name,
                         "human1" = "Human 1",
                         "human2" = "Human 2",
                         "tool" = "Tool",
                         rater_name)
    p <- ggplot(long, aes(x = Given, y = True, fill = Prob)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white") +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkgreen", limits = c(0, 1)) +
      theme_light() +
      labs(
        title = paste0(model_name, "\n", rater_label),
        x = "Observed class",
        y = "True class C_i"
      ) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    
    plots_list[[model_name]] <- p
  }
  
  # Combine plots
  library(gridExtra)
  p_combined <- do.call(grid.arrange, c(plots_list, ncol = 2))
  
  ggsave(file.path(comp_dir, paste0("theta_comparison_", rater_name, ".png")), 
         p_combined, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 600)
  
  return(p_combined)
}

# Create comparison plots for each rater
p_theta_h1_comp <- plot_theta_comparison("human1", 1)
p_theta_h2_comp <- plot_theta_comparison("human2", 2)
p_theta_tool_comp <- plot_theta_comparison("tool", 3)

cat("\n=== Comparison complete ===\n")
cat("All comparison plots saved to:", comp_dir, "\n")
```
